hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && { git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}' >/dev/null 2>&1 && git pull --rebase --autostash 2>&1 || echo 'Auto-sync: no upstream branch tracked yet, skipping pull'; }

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -m 'Auto-sync: automated commit via Claude Code Stop hook' >/dev/null && (git push -u origin HEAD 2>&1 || (git pull --rebase --autostash 2>&1 && git push -u origin HEAD 2>&1)); fi
